[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0006 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future]
Building the Intelligent Future

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0007 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future]
InGen Dynamics is building a suite of AI-powered robotics platforms and automation systems designed to help people live fuller, safer, and more productive lives — wherever they are in the world.

"We passionately believe that Robotics and AI have the potential to improve our lives in ways we have never yet imagined." — Arshad Hisham, Founder & CEO

Our goal is to help millions of people — regardless of where they live or work — benefit from intelligent, practical robotics and AI. This is not just a commercial objective. It is the reason InGen Dynamics exists.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0028 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future > Watch Our Innovations]
Watch Our Innovations

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0029 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Watch Our Innovations]
Witness our robotics and AI solutions firsthand — from autonomous delivery to intelligent home automation.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0030 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
Recognised by the World's Best

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0031 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
In 2015, Arshad Hisham founded InGen Dynamics, that quickly rose to prominence in the AI and robotics industry. The company has gained international media attention, prestigious awards, and academic recognition.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0032 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
inGen Dynamics is turning heads, recently securing a three-fold increase in its investment commitment from GEM, soaring from $50 million to a staggering $150 million.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0033 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
Despite being just over eight years old, InGen has established a formidable suite of products. The investment commitment from GEM grew from $50M in 2021 to a whopping $150M.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0034 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
InGen Dynamics is not just a tech company; it's a beacon for progress. With its compelling vision and innovative products, it serves as a vivid illustration of the power and potential of AI and robotics.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0035 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
Thanks to inGen Dynamics, we are poised to enter an era of advanced AI and robotics that aim to elevate human capabilities. What sets them apart is their unique phased approach.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0036 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
The University of Manchester has signed a strategic MoU with InGen Dynamics to create a dynamic ecosystem where academia and industry work hand-in-hand to develop AI-powered solutions across healthcare, social care, education, and sustainability.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0037 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
ASME featured InGen Dynamics in a cover article exploring the future of intelligent home systems — highlighting the company's integrated approach to AI, robotics, and automation as a model for how technology will reshape everyday living environments.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0038 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Recognised by the World's Best]
InGen Dynamics continues to diversify the application of AI and robotics technologies — building a comprehensive product ecosystem that spans home automation, security, healthcare, and education.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0039 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future > InGen Dynamics at a Glance]
InGen Dynamics at a Glance

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0040 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future > Featured Worldwide]
Featured Worldwide

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0041 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Featured Worldwide]
"This is more than just a business — it is a shared mission to utilise advanced AI and robotics to elevate human capabilities and improve living standards worldwide."

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0042 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Featured Worldwide]
I founded InGen Dynamics at the intersection of artificial intelligence , robotics, and automation — assembling a product ecosystem of nine products including Sentinel, Aido, Fari, Senpai, Carry & Go, Origami AI, Quantum Leap, Kaiser.Haus, and Futurenauts. Together, our Sentinel and Kaiser.Haus systems have surpassed one million hours of field operations. We have secured $157 million in investment commitments — anchored by GEM’s $150 million — and built an $80 million revenue pipeline across the portfolio.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0043 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Featured Worldwide]
I have had the distinction of receiving a private invitation from the U.S. Secretary of Commerce and UK Secretary of State to the US Presidential State Visit reception at Lancaster House, London. Our ventures were recognised by the UK Prime Minister’s Office at No. 10 Downing Street for contributions to advancing UK innovation in AI, automation, education, and robotics. I have delivered keynotes at Walt Disney Imagineering , BCG’s AI Summit in Chicago, the IEEE Robotics Summit at Columbia University, the Volvo Group alongside the MD of NVIDIA, and AT&T’s Global Advisory Council — as one of only five speakers invited to present to the AT&T Global CEO .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0044 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Featured Worldwide]
Futurenauts , our education platform, now equips learners from high school to corporate level across 600+ institutions worldwide. Every product we build makes the next one smarter . Every market we enter deepens our platform . This is not merely a commercial objective — it is the reason InGen Dynamics exists .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0045 | heading | Building the Intelligent Future > Ready to Learn More?]
Ready to Learn More?

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0046 | paragraph | Building the Intelligent Future > Ready to Learn More?]
Explore our product ecosystem, meet our world-class team, or connect with us.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0047 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life]
We Bring Intelligence to Life

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0048 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life]
AI today can think. It can write. It can reason. But it cannot move through your hospital corridor, teach your child, patrol your campus, or care for your grandmother. We are building the bridge between digital intelligence and the physical world — across robots, cities, and people.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0049 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
It Started with a Simple Question

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0050 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
What if the same intelligence powering your search engine could walk into a hospital ward, greet a lonely grandparent, or teach a child in a village without a single teacher?

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0051 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
In 2015, Arshad Hisham — an engineer, educator, and serial entrepreneur — founded InGen Dynamics in Santa Clara, California, with a conviction that felt almost audacious: AI should not live only in the cloud. It should move, learn, and serve in the real world.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0052 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
What began as a single prototype on a workbench has grown into a nine-product AI and robotics ecosystem , recognised by governments, featured in the world’s most prestigious media, and deployed across three continents. Over one million hours of real-world AI operations have been logged. More than 600 academic institutions have been reached through InGen’s education programmes.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0053 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
“We don’t build robots for the sake of technology. We build them because someone’s grandmother deserves dignity in her final years, and someone’s child deserves a future they can see.”

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0054 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
— Arshad Hisham, Founder & CEO

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0055 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question]
THE INGEN PRODUCT ECOSYSTEM — FROM TABLETOP TO HUMANOID

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0056 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
AI Is Trapped in the Cloud

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0057 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
The physical world runs on people, sensors, and machines — not cloud APIs. Healthcare workers are burned out. Classrooms are overcrowded. Infrastructure is crumbling under labour shortages. And the elderly are increasingly alone.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0058 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
Global nursing shortage projected to reach 13 million by 2030. AI-assisted care is no longer optional — it is essential for patient outcomes and staff wellbeing.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0059 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
250 million children worldwide lack access to quality education. AI-powered learning tools are designed to democratise knowledge regardless of geography or income.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0060 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
Critical infrastructure inspection and security still rely heavily on manual patrols. Autonomous systems are intended to increase coverage while reducing risk to human workers.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0061 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
By 2050, the global population aged 60+ is expected to reach 2.1 billion. Companion robotics is being developed to help older adults live independently with dignity.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0062 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud]
Market data from public third-party sources (WHO, UNESCO, WEF). Forward-looking product descriptions reflect design intent.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0063 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World]
Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0064 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World]
Most AI companies build software. We build the bridge between software intelligence and physical action . Origami AI is our hardware-agnostic, edge-native, multimodal platform — a single intelligence layer that powers every product we make.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0065 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World]
When Sentinel learns to detect a threat pattern in a parking lot, that knowledge transfers to Rover patrolling an agricultural field. When Senpai learns how a child responds to a maths lesson, that pedagogical understanding enriches Fari’s conversations with an elderly patient. Every deployment makes every product smarter.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0066 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World]
This is the principle of “One Brain, Many Bodies” — shared intelligence that compounds with every interaction, every environment, every use case. It is what we believe will allow a small, focused company to compete at the frontier of embodied AI.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0067 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World]
Forward-looking description reflects design intent. Product capabilities are in various stages of development.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0068 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture]
Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0069 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture]
We don’t try to solve everything at once. Our strategy sequences product development by complexity — proving the platform in simpler form factors before tackling harder engineering challenges.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0070 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture]
Aido tabletop robots, Fari eldercare, Senpai education, and Kobe fitness bundles. These simpler form factors allow us to reach early markets, validate the Origami AI platform, and generate real-world operational data.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0071 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture]
Carry & Go for indoor logistics, Sentinel Prime for enterprise security, and Aido Rover for outdoor patrol and inspection. These mobile platforms tackle harder navigation, obstacle avoidance, and multi-sensor fusion challenges.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0072 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Phased by Complexity, Unified by Architecture]
The Origami AI platform is designed to scale as a commercial Platform-as-a-Service, and the InGen Humanoid programme represents our longer-term ambition for generalist robots capable of human-like manipulation and interaction.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0073 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
Where Innovation Meets Policy

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0074 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
InGen Dynamics and its founder have been recognised at the highest levels of government and industry, building the kind of institutional credibility that opens doors for real-world deployment.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0075 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
Private invitation from the U.S. Secretary of Commerce and UK Secretary of State to the distinguished Business Reception during the Presidential State Visit — part of the Economic Prosperity Deal.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0076 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
No. 10 Downing Street recognised InGen’s contributions to advancing UK innovation in AI, Automation, Education, and Robotics.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0077 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
Invited by the Government of India to design national AI, Ethics & Governance curriculum for the IAS/IPS/IFS civil services — the country’s most elite administrative branches.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0078 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
Honoured for outstanding contributions to science and technology innovation. Named alongside the most consequential inventions in the United States.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0079 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
MIT, TEDx, IEEE (Columbia University), BCG, Walt Disney Imagineering, 92Y City of Tomorrow, Volvo Group alongside NVIDIA, AT&T Global CEO Advisory Council.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0080 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Where Innovation Meets Policy]
Amazon Top 10 AI Bestseller. Academic citations by MIT, Univ. of Pennsylvania, Plymouth, Washington, Kassel, and Alicante. ASME cover article. Work exhibited at SAASC Museum, Kuwait.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0081 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good]
A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0082 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good]
We envision a world where automation, driven by AI and robotics, transforms industries — making dangerous work optional, making education universally accessible, making healthcare available to the most vulnerable. Not a world where humans are replaced, but where humans are freed to do what only humans can: create, empathise, imagine, and lead.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0083 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good]
The near-term market for healthcare, education, retail, hospitality, and security automation is estimated by third-party analysts at approximately $4 trillion. The longer-term addressable market for embodied AI — spanning manufacturing, agriculture, logistics, and infrastructure — is measured in the tens of trillions. We are in the early chapters of what may be the largest technological transformation in human history.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0084 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good]
Market estimates from public third-party sources. Forward-looking statements reflect current expectations and are not guarantees of future results.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0085 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Trust Starts in the Classroom]
AI Trust Starts in the Classroom

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0086 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Trust Starts in the Classroom]
People don’t adopt what they don’t understand. That’s why we built Futurenauts — not as a side project, but as a core strategic pillar. It is our built-in trust and adoption engine.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0087 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Trust Starts in the Classroom]
From K–12 junkbots workshops that have reached 600+ academic institutions across Europe and the Middle East, to a full engineering degree curriculum now taught at leading global universities, to AI literacy programmes for corporate executives — Futurenauts is designed to create the customers, policymakers, and engineers of tomorrow.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0088 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Trust Starts in the Classroom]
Over 1 million hours of AI education have been delivered to date. Curriculum is aligned with UNICEF, ABET, and NEP 2020 standards. Partnerships span from Carnegie Mellon to Berkeley to the Government of India’s national civil service academy.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0089 | heading | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Join the Revolution]
Join the Revolution

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0090 | paragraph | We Bring Intelligence to Life > Join the Revolution]
Explore our product ecosystem, meet our world-class team, or dive into our decade-long journey of building intelligence that moves.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0091 | heading | One Platform, Nine Products]
One Platform, Nine Products

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0092 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products]
Built on Origami AI — what we learn in one product benefits all. Phased by complexity, unified by architecture.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0093 | heading | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap]
Product Roadmap

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0094 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap]
Our phased strategy sequences development by complexity — starting with proven products before tackling harder engineering challenges. At the heart of our roadmap is the Origami AI platform , which serves as the cornerstone of our AI architecture. This integrated system has been accumulating our knowledge and expertise since 2015 and guides our progress as we strive to create increasingly sophisticated products and robots.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0095 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap]
The first stage involves integrating our Aido Units as the primary robot platform, equipped with various mobility add-ons to impact different sectors. We are also preparing to introduce the CarrynGo and Rover form factors, specifically designed for retail, hospitality, and restaurants. Other specialized product lines include Fari (healthcare), Senpai (education), and Sentinel (surveillance). By providing tailored solutions, we address immediate market needs and play a significant role in overcoming labour shortages.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0096 | heading | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
Quantum Leap & Futurenauts

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0097 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
The inGen Quantum Leap is a transformative AI and Automation Framework designed to revolutionize business operations across industries. The InGen Insight Engine , a core component, provides detailed analysis of operations and strategic goals, tailoring AI solutions that boost efficiency and profitability.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0098 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
Parallel to our technological advancements, the Futurenauts Series provides cutting-edge skills in AI, robotics, and automation — from the Launchpad for high school students to Professional Edge for corporate training. Together, these programs ensure InGen Dynamics continues to lead at the forefront of the technological revolution.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0099 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
A state-of-the-art software, sensor components, and hardware technologies to covertly deploy as a layered multi-sensor platform to detect, recognize, and combat active events including threats before they occur. Sentinel delivers highly accurate deep learning and AI based real-time event detections. More than half a million hours of field operations to date.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0100 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
An autonomous security robot, designed for diverse terrains, and optimally equipped for areas such as airports, correctional facilities, agricultural farms, expansive corporate parks, federal government establishments, solar power fields, utility power substations, and wind power plantations. Fully interfaced with the Origami AI platform and inGen Control Center.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0101 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
Ideal for transportation of food, beverages, and open-tray items. This autonomous point-to-point delivery system caters to restaurants, food courts, offices, retail spaces, and more. Also incorporates authentication controls and ensures secure package deliveries in compartments equipped with automatic doors.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0102 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
Specially designed for older adults to give them everything they need to stay focused, connected, and engaged. Fari interaction is easy and fun, and her powerful AI and Machine Learning modules make her even more helpful by learning what you like and need. Fari is your companion for your golden years.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0103 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
The next generation educational robot platform: A state-of-the-art machine with unlimited possibilities at an incredibly attractive price point. Designed to delight, educate, and empower children as they mature into responsible social adults in the 21st Century.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0104 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
KOBE brings security, safety, companionship, health, and a connected peace of mind to your home, apartment, and condo. Always there waiting for you, greeting you, helping you, having fun with you, working out with you, and protecting you 24 hours a day. The ultimate room-mate.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0105 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
When we set out to create Kaiser.HAUS, we wanted to design the ultimate smart home experience. Kaiser is incredibly powerful, yet simple to use. With advanced automation and integrated technology whose sole purpose is to make your home a truly delightful environment.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0106 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]
Utilizing state-of-the-art Laser SLAM and 3D camera multi-sensor fusion algorithms, these robots offer unparalleled navigation precision and positioning accuracy. Equipped with lidar detection with a range of up to 25 meters, providing real-time dynamic environmental data.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-INGEN-HOME-20260812::block-0107 | paragraph | One Platform, Nine Products > Product Roadmap > Quantum Leap & Futurenauts]

source_blocks.text: We Bring Intelligence to Life

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life
source_blocks.text: AI today can think. It can write. It can reason. But it cannot move through your hospital corridor, teach your child, patrol your campus, or care for your grandmother. We are building the bridge between digital intelligence and the physical world — across robots, cities, and people.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: It Started with a Simple Question

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: What if the same intelligence powering your search engine could walk into a hospital ward, greet a lonely grandparent, or teach a child in a village without a single teacher?

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: In 2015, Arshad Hisham — an engineer, educator, and serial entrepreneur — founded InGen Dynamics in Santa Clara, California, with a conviction that felt almost audacious: AI should not live only in the cloud. It should move, learn, and serve in the real world.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: What began as a single prototype on a workbench has grown into a nine-product AI and robotics ecosystem , recognised by governments, featured in the world’s most prestigious media, and deployed across three continents. Over one million hours of real-world AI operations have been logged. More than 600 academic institutions have been reached through InGen’s education programmes.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: “We don’t build robots for the sake of technology. We build them because someone’s grandmother deserves dignity in her final years, and someone’s child deserves a future they can see.”

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > It Started with a Simple Question
source_blocks.text: — Arshad Hisham, Founder & CEO

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud
source_blocks.text: The physical world runs on people, sensors, and machines — not cloud APIs. Healthcare workers are burned out. Classrooms are overcrowded. Infrastructure is crumbling under labour shortages. And the elderly are increasingly alone.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud
source_blocks.text: Global nursing shortage projected to reach 13 million by 2030. AI-assisted care is no longer optional — it is essential for patient outcomes and staff wellbeing.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud
source_blocks.text: 250 million children worldwide lack access to quality education. AI-powered learning tools are designed to democratise knowledge regardless of geography or income.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud
source_blocks.text: Critical infrastructure inspection and security still rely heavily on manual patrols. Autonomous systems are intended to increase coverage while reducing risk to human workers.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > AI Is Trapped in the Cloud
source_blocks.text: By 2050, the global population aged 60+ is expected to reach 2.1 billion. Companion robotics is being developed to help older adults live independently with dignity.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World
source_blocks.text: Most AI companies build software. We build the bridge between software intelligence and physical action . Origami AI is our hardware-agnostic, edge-native, multimodal platform — a single intelligence layer that powers every product we make.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World
source_blocks.text: When Sentinel learns to detect a threat pattern in a parking lot, that knowledge transfers to Rover patrolling an agricultural field. When Senpai learns how a child responds to a maths lesson, that pedagogical understanding enriches Fari’s conversations with an elderly patient. Every deployment makes every product smarter.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > Origami AI — The Application Layer for the Physical World
source_blocks.text: This is the principle of “One Brain, Many Bodies” — shared intelligence that compounds with every interaction, every environment, every use case. It is what we believe will allow a small, focused company to compete at the frontier of embodied AI.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good
source_blocks.text: We envision a world where automation, driven by AI and robotics, transforms industries — making dangerous work optional, making education universally accessible, making healthcare available to the most vulnerable. Not a world where humans are replaced, but where humans are freed to do what only humans can: create, empathise, imagine, and lead.

source_blocks.path: We Bring Intelligence to Life > A Future Where Technology Serves the Greater Good
source_blocks.text: The near-term market for healthcare, education, retail, hospitality, and security automation is estimated by third-party analysts at approximately $4 trillion. The longer-term addressable market for embodied AI — spanning manufacturing, agriculture, logistics, and infrastructure — is measured in the tens of trillions. We are in the early chapters of what may be the largest technological transformation in human history.

source_blocks.text: Security management executive with 20+ years of experience in global security strategies, risk management, executive protection and counterintelligence operations spanning a Fortune Magazine Top 10 globally managed health care company, a leading pharmaceutical and agro-chemical company, and federal law enforcement. Leads special projects in AI and automation integration across InGen's product portfolio, driving cross-functional initiatives that accelerate product development and market entry.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Driving strategy for intelligent automation and the Quantum Leap enterprise transformation framework. Responsible for aligning AI deployment with business operational goals across client organisations, ensuring seamless integration and measurable value creation through the InGen Insight Engine and Implementation Orbit methodologies.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Brings a remarkable 20-year career built with world-renowned companies including bp, Air bp and Castrol. Strategic focus on B2B marketing across diverse sectors — Automotive, Energy, Aviation, and Commercial Fleet, Mobility and Convenience. Led the European rollout of low-carbon energy solutions at bp Mobility & Convenience, championing fleet decarbonisation marketing communications. Extensive expertise in product innovation and multi-channel marketing execution. As Global Energy Offer Development Manager at Castrol, project managed creation of new environmental subsea product line and optimised global offers for Energy sectors.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Managing special initiatives and strategic projects across the InGen portfolio. Coordinates cross-functional teams to deliver key company milestones, driving execution across product development, partnerships, and operational scaling initiatives.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Seasoned management consultant, corporate strategist, and investment banker with over 25 years advising and scaling technology companies. President of New Market Venture Management LLC, specialising in business strategy, M&A, and capital raises from Silicon Valley VCs. Registered Representative of Finalis Securities LLC. Expertise spans AI, machine learning, SaaS, and big data. Has worked with Scepter Inc., Adhera Health, Atinary Technologies, FACTIC, and Visualnet. Involved in numerous M&A transactions combining corporate finance with deep technology understanding.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Highly accomplished technology executive and mentor with two decades of leadership in corporate development, business strategy, and emerging technologies. Managing Director of Technology Ventures Group. Ambassador for Navispace. IEEE Region 6 Director-Elect overseeing 10,000+ members in Silicon Valley. Senior positions at NEC, Wong's International, and Inventec Corporation with partnerships at Apple, HP, Intel, and Dell. Founded the Silicon Valley NFC App Developer Meetup. Active with Alchemist Accelerator, Plug and Play Tech Center, and Women's Startup Lab.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Dynamic executive with over 30 years at Accenture, PeopleSoft, Portal Software, and Oracle. Led global sales and GTM for seven years. Expertise in building world-class teams, maximising sales productivity, and delivering consultative selling across global markets. Active strategic advisor and mentor to early-stage AI startups.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Over 20 years of expertise in product design, digital transformation, and strategic leadership. Currently leading Sixth Capital, integrating social capital within the venture ecosystem. Experience at IBM and Blue Jeans Network, leading initiatives that transformed user experiences and contributed to successful exits. Scaled a Silicon Valley startup to $100M ARR. Specialises in GTM strategies, product-led growth, and growth design. Directed UX initiatives supporting over $4BN in revenue.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Driving transformative growth through people-focused leadership and innovative technology adoption. Currently COO at Gulf Marine Pte Ltd. Ten years in automotive leading technology, sales, marketing, and M&A teams; ten years in shipping leading operations, supply chain, and innovation. Designed a predictive algorithm delivering 99% supply chain reliability. Optimised chassis of a fully electric commercial vehicle. Lived and worked in Bangalore, London, Prague, Hong Kong, and Singapore.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: Senior finance professional with 15+ years in management consulting. Deep expertise in business and finance transformation and strategic performance management. source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission
source_blocks.text: World-leading authority on machine learning and robotics with applications in cargo handling, mining, and defence. Pioneer of probabilistic robot navigation and SLAM. NSW Chief Scientist and Engineer, on leave as Professor at University of Sydney. Former Chief Scientific Advisor to the UK Ministry of Defence (2017–18). Former CEO of NICTA (2010–2015). Director of ACFR and ARC CAS (1995–2010). Lecturer at University of Oxford and Fellow of Oriel College (1986–1995). Co-founded three successful startups. 350+ research papers. 2010 NSW Scientist of the Year. Fellow of IEEE, Australian Academy of Science, Royal Academy of Engineering, and Royal Society of London.

source_blocks.path: The People Behind the Mission

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything
source_blocks.text: We didn’t start InGen Dynamics to build robots. We started it because we believe that AI and robotics can fundamentally improve how people live, learn, work, and age — and that this belief carries a moral obligation to act.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Why We Exist
source_blocks.text: Why We Exist

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Why We Exist
source_blocks.text: At InGen Dynamics, our purpose is to utilize advanced AI and robotics to elevate human capabilities and improve living standards worldwide . We believe in building a future where technology serves the greater good and enhances the lives of millions.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Why We Exist
source_blocks.text: Our mission is to create robots and AI products that enhance people’s lives, eradicate unsafe jobs, and contribute to humanity’s betterment. We are driven by a moral obligation to ensure a positive impact on the future of humanity, and we see the development of technology as crucial to achieving this goal.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Why We Exist
source_blocks.text: With our formidable suite of products — from Sentinel protecting infrastructure to Fari caring for the elderly, from Senpai educating children to Carry & Go automating logistics — we are committed to bringing useful and impactful products to market that solve real problems for real people.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Where We’re Going
source_blocks.text: Where We’re Going

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Where We’re Going
source_blocks.text: Our vision is to be at the forefront of the AI and robotics revolution, shaping the course of history. We envision a world where automation, driven by AI and robotics, revolutionises various industries , making manual labor optional and increasing production.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Where We’re Going
source_blocks.text: By deploying our robots and AI products, equipped with advanced capabilities and powerful AI, we aim to eliminate the need for dangerous and unpleasant jobs, paving the way for a happier and more fulfilling life for future generations.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Where We’re Going
source_blocks.text: We strive to transform industries such as healthcare, education, retail, hospitality, and surveillance , addressing the growing need for automation and service robotics. Our goal is to create a future where technology empowers humanity and contributes to the betterment of society.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Five Pillars That Define How We Build
source_blocks.text: Five Pillars That Define How We Build

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Five Pillars That Define How We Build
source_blocks.text: At InGen Dynamics, we have a vision for the future where general-purpose robots and AI products eliminate dangerous and unpleasant jobs. Our culture is built around five non-negotiable principles.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > What We Stand For
source_blocks.text: Beyond our five cultural pillars, three foundational commitments guide every decision we make — from product design to hiring to partnerships.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > Where We Operate
source_blocks.text: From Silicon Valley to London, Dubai to Shenzhen, Doha to Bangalore — our distributed team operates across multiple time zones, serving customers and partners on four continents.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > What the World Could Look Like
source_blocks.text: Once we succeed in our mission, the world will witness a transformation. Manual labor will become optional as robots equipped with advanced capabilities take over structured and repetitive tasks, allowing humans to focus on more creative and fulfilling endeavors.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > What the World Could Look Like
source_blocks.text: Industries such as healthcare, education, retail, hospitality, and surveillance will experience a revolution, with AI and robotics enhancing productivity, improving outcomes, and addressing labour shortages. There will be an abundance of affordable goods and services, leading to potential wealth increases for everyone.

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > What the World Could Look Like
source_blocks.text: Our success will result in a future where technology serves the greater good, creating a safer, more efficient, and happier world for all .

source_blocks.path: The Principles That Drive Everything > What the World Could Look Like

documents.content:
[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0001 | heading | The companion 
every elder deserves.]
The companion 
every elder deserves.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0002 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves.]
Fari is designed to deliver clinical-grade health monitoring with the warmth of a trusted friend — combining advanced AI with an unwavering commitment to dignity, privacy, and human authority.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0003 | heading | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Three pillars of compassionate care.]
Three pillars of compassionate care.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0004 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Three pillars of compassionate care.]
Fari is being designed to address the three dimensions of eldercare that matter most — clinical health monitoring, emotional wellbeing, and physical safety.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0005 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Three pillars of compassionate care.]
Designed for continuous, non-invasive vital sign tracking — heart rate, SpO₂, respiratory rate, skin temperature, and blood pressure estimation. AI models are being developed to detect subtle health pattern changes before they become emergencies.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0006 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Three pillars of compassionate care.]
Our Affective Multi-modal Depression Classifier (AMDC) is designed to analyse facial micro-expressions, vocal prosody, and behavioural patterns to assess emotional wellbeing — enabling proactive companionship and caregiver alerts.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0007 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Three pillars of compassionate care.]
Fall detection and prevention using the Human Trajectory Detection system (HTD-IRL). Designed to predict fall risk from gait analysis and environmental scanning, with target alert latency of under 3.2 seconds from detection to caregiver notification.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0008 | heading | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
Designed to care in every way.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0009 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
A selection of Fari's planned capabilities — each governed by our SEOM ethical framework to ensure dignity, privacy, and human authority at every interaction.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0010 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
Designed to deliver personalised medication reminders with visual and audio cues, confirm intake via computer vision, and alert caregivers to missed doses. SEOM Rule F02 governs all medication interactions.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0011 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
Natural language interaction designed to reduce loneliness. Fari's Socially-aware Trajectory Understanding Model (STUM) is designed to calibrate conversation style based on resident preferences and emotional state.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0012 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
Using mmWave radar and depth cameras, Fari is designed to monitor gait patterns and predict fall risk. The HTD-IRL model uses inverse reinforcement learning to identify pre-fall biomechanical signatures.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0013 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Designed to care in every way.]
WBT1 mobility platform designed for smooth, safe navigation in care environments. Multi-sensor SLAM with LiDAR, depth cameras, and ultrasonic arrays enables obstacle avoidance and room-to-room autonomy.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0014 | heading | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Watch what we're building.]
Watch what we're building.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0015 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Watch what we're building.]
Our Vimeo showcase brings Fari to life — the team, the technology, and the vision behind InGen Dynamics' eldercare AI companion . Features shown are in active development and subject to change.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0016 | heading | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Ready to bring Fari to your care facility?]
Ready to bring Fari to your care facility?

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0017 | paragraph | The companion 
every elder deserves. > Ready to bring Fari to your care facility?]
We are actively engaging with care providers, health systems, and research partners. Let's explore how Fari could support your residents and staff.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0018 | heading | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
35+ capabilities designed for care.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0019 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Every feature Fari is being designed to deliver — each governed by the SEOM ethical framework. All capabilities represent design targets and are subject to change during development.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0020 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed to monitor heart rate, SpO₂, respiratory rate, skin temperature, and blood pressure estimation continuously via non-invasive sensors.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0021 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Non-contact sleep monitoring designed to track sleep stages, breathing patterns, and nocturnal movement using mmWave radar and ambient sensors.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0022 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
AI designed to establish individual baseline health profiles during a 14-day onboarding period, enabling detection of subtle deviations from personal norms.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0023 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed to track room temperature, humidity, air quality, and light levels to identify environmental factors affecting resident health and comfort.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0024 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed to synchronise observations with Electronic Health Records via HL7 FHIR R4 APIs, enabling seamless clinical data flow with target sync latency under 5 minutes.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0025 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Personalised audio and visual medication reminders designed with escalation protocols — gentle prompt → detailed instructions → caregiver alert. Governed by SEOM Rule F02.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0026 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Computer vision designed to visually confirm medication intake and detect potential missed doses, logging all events for clinical review.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0027 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
AMDC model designed to analyse facial micro-expressions, vocal prosody, and behavioural patterns to assess emotional state with target accuracy of 87.4%.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0028 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Natural language interaction designed to reduce feelings of loneliness. STUM model calibrates conversation style, topic selection, and emotional tone to each resident.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0029 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed to suggest and facilitate cognitive exercises, music therapy, reminiscence activities, and gentle physical exercises tailored to individual capability and preference.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0030 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Video calling with auto-framing (target 1080p), wellbeing digest sharing, and activity photo sharing — all governed by SEOM F08 and F10 consent rules.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0031 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Multi-sensor fall detection designed with target response time of under 3.2 seconds from detection to caregiver notification. Uses depth cameras and mmWave radar.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0032 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
HTD-IRL model designed to analyse gait patterns using inverse reinforcement learning to identify pre-fall biomechanical signatures and alert staff proactively.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0033 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
SEOM Rule F03 mandates that emergency detection always takes priority over all other operations. Designed with multi-channel alerting: on-device, dashboard, mobile push, and SMS.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0034 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed for residents with cognitive impairment — monitors movement patterns and triggers alerts when unusual wandering behaviour is detected, especially during night hours.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0035 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
WBT1 mobility platform with multi-sensor SLAM using LiDAR, depth cameras, and ultrasonic arrays. Designed for smooth, safe movement through complex care environments.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0036 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Designed for scheduled and on-demand room visits, enabling Fari to check on residents, deliver medication reminders, and provide companionship across an entire care facility.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0037 | paragraph | 35+ capabilities designed for care.]
Real-time obstacle detection and path planning designed with safety-first principles — Fari is designed to always yield to humans and stop immediately on contact detection.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0038 | heading | Built for the edge. Governed by ethics.]
Built for the edge. Governed by ethics.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0039 | paragraph | Built for the edge. Governed by ethics.]
Fari's technology stack combines edge AI processing, a 14-sensor suite, and the SEOM ethical framework — all designed to run locally on NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX for privacy-first operation.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0040 | heading | Built for the edge. Governed by ethics. > Clinical-grade hardware design.]

Design for people who need it most.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0102 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most.]
Fari's UX design system is built around a single principle: every interface decision must serve the resident, the caregiver, and the family simultaneously — each with radically different cognitive loads, emotional contexts, and time pressures.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0103 | heading | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Six principles that govern every pixel.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0104 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Fari operates at the intersection of clinical care and human dignity. Every interface element is filtered through these principles in order of priority.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0105 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Every screen element is filtered through SEOM Rule F04. No labels that pathologise, no alerts that embarrass. Language always uses observation framing — "Fari observed elevated heart rate" not "cardiac event."

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0106 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Colour temperature, animation easing, and language tone are calibrated to feel warm and reassuring, never clinical or alarming. The resident display is designed never to show anything anxiety-inducing.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0107 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Information density varies by audience: residents see simple, large-type reassurance; caregivers see data-rich dashboards; families see curated wellbeing digests. Same data, three interfaces.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0108 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Privacy is not a settings toggle — it is embedded in the interface architecture. Camera feeds are processed on-device and never stored. The resident display cannot show raw biometric data.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0109 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
Every AI recommendation is visually differentiated from confirmed information. Confidence scores are displayed alongside all AI outputs. Action buttons always say "Suggest" not "Do."

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0110 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Six principles that govern every pixel.]
While the visual language is warm, the underlying data presentation is clinically precise. Vital signs are displayed with proper units, reference ranges, and trend indicators.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0111 | heading | Design for people who need it most. > The visual language of care.]
The visual language of care.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0112 | heading | Design for people who need it most. > Three surfaces. Nine screen states.]
Three surfaces. Nine screen states.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0113 | paragraph | Design for people who need it most. > Three surfaces. Nine screen states.]
Same data, three radically different presentations — each optimised for the cognitive load, emotional context, and time pressure of its audience.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-FARI-20260812::block-0114 | heading | Design for people who need it most. > Four critical workflows. SEOM-gated throughout.]
Four critical workflows. SEOM-gated throughout.

Fari's interfaces are being designed to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards across all surfaces, with specific accommodations for the common sensory, motor, and cognitive challenges faced by elderly residents.

supported_facts.statement: Our Vimeo showcase brings Fari to life — the team, the technology, and the vision behind InGen Dynamics' eldercare AI companion . Features shown are in active development and subject to change.
Every feature Fari is being designed to deliver — each governed by the SEOM ethical framework. All capabilities represent design targets and are subject to change during development.
Fari is being designed to address the three dimensions of eldercare that matter most — clinical health monitoring, emotional wellbeing, and physical safety.
Designed to monitor heart rate, SpO₂, respiratory rate, skin temperature, and blood pressure estimation continuously via non-invasive sensors.
Personalised audio and visual medication reminders designed with escalation protocols — gentle prompt → detailed instructions → caregiver alert. Governed by SEOM Rule F02.
Every AI recommendation is visually differentiated from confirmed information. Confidence scores are displayed alongside all AI outputs. Action buttons always say "Suggest" not "Do."
SYS-004 | Edge AI processing on NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX — no raw biometric cloud transmission | Privacy | MUST | Architecture review
Privacy is not a settings toggle — it is embedded in the interface architecture. Camera feeds are processed on-device and never stored. The resident display cannot show raw biometric data.
The Supervised Ethical Override Module governs every AI decision Fari makes. These rules are immutable — they cannot be overridden by any other system objective, even to improve performance.
SEOM Rule F03 mandates that emergency detection always takes priority over all other operations. Designed with multi-channel alerting: on-device, dashboard, mobile push, and SMS.
SYS-002 | Fall detection with target alert latency <3.2 seconds | Safety | MUST | Lab + field test
SYS-008 | EHR integration via HL7 FHIR R4 with target sync <5 minutes | Integration | MUST | Integration test
Falls, cardiac events, unresponsive resident. Multi-channel alert: on-device alarm, dashboard popup, mobile push, SMS.
Vital trend deviations, missed medications, unusual activity patterns. Dashboard alert with caregiver notification.
Wellbeing updates, activity summaries, environmental conditions. Logged and batched for shift handover reports.
Information density varies by audience: residents see simple, large-type reassurance; caregivers see data-rich dashboards; families see curated wellbeing digests. Same data, three interfaces.
Same data, three radically different presentations — each optimised for the cognitive load, emotional context, and time pressure of its audience.
Multi-sensor fall detection designed with target response time of under 3.2 seconds from detection to caregiver notification. Uses depth cameras and mmWave radar.
Designed to synchronise observations with Electronic Health Records via HL7 FHIR R4 APIs, enabling seamless clinical data flow with target sync latency under 5 minutes.

Complete sensor array: mmWave radar, depth camera, RGB camera, thermal camera, microphone array, environmental sensors, LiDAR, ultrasonics, IMU, ambient light, battery monitor, contact sensors, encoders, PPG.
NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (100 TOPS), 16GB LPDDR5, 256GB NVMe SSD. Runs all AI inference on-device. Designed for privacy-first edge computing with no raw biometric data transmitted to cloud.

Every screen element is filtered through SEOM Rule F04. No labels that pathologise, no alerts that embarrass. Language always uses observation framing — "Fari observed elevated heart rate" not "cardiac event."
Each track delivers independently but synchronises at gate reviews. SEOM compliance is verified at every gate — no track proceeds without ethical clearance.

Owns Interface Control Document for all 15 inter-subsystem interfaces. IVT test harness, end-to-end latency verification, SEOM full-system audit, EU AI Act compliance documentation, CQC/CMS reporting templates.
HL7 FHIR R4 API client for electronic health record synchronisation. Designed for bi-directional data flow with target sync latency <5 minutes. mTLS encrypted transport.
Designed to assess emotional wellbeing through facial expression, vocal prosody, and activity pattern analysis. Target accuracy: 87.4%. Reports observations, never diagnoses (SEOM F09).
Uses inverse reinforcement learning to model human movement patterns and predict fall risk from gait analysis. Designed to detect pre-fall biomechanical signatures for preventive alerts.
Hosts GRPO, SEOM, STUM, AMDC, HTD-IRL, and CRL-MRS models. Model orchestration, inference pipeline, and SEOM ethical compliance layer. All inference on Jetson edge.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0001 | paragraph | Document]
Development Notice: Senpai is a product in active development by InGen Dynamics. Features and capabilities described reflect our current design intent and development roadmap. Specifications are subject to change.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0002 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child.]
Intelligent education, built for every child.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0003 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child.]
Senpai is an AI-powered educational companion robot being developed by InGen Dynamics — designed to adapt to how each child learns, support students with special educational needs, and bring personalised teaching to classrooms and homes at scale.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0004 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > See Senpai in action .]
See Senpai in action .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0005 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > See Senpai in action .]
Product concepts, design intent, and the InGen Dynamics vision for the future of educational robotics.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0006 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > A gap that technology has not yet closed .]
A gap that technology has not yet closed .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0007 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > A gap that technology has not yet closed .]
Education has two extremes. Software that scales but cannot teach. Specialists who teach brilliantly but cannot scale. Every child between those two points is underserved.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0008 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > A gap that technology has not yet closed .]
Senpai is being developed to occupy the space between — a physical AI companion designed to bring the adaptive intelligence of a great teacher to every child, regardless of where they learn, what their needs are, or what language they speak at home.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0009 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Three ideas at the heart of Senpai .]
Three ideas at the heart of Senpai .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0010 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Six markets. One platform .]
Six markets. One platform .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0011 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Six markets. One platform .]
Senpai's architecture is being designed to serve multiple education verticals through curriculum and configuration adaptation — without requiring a separate product for each segment. All market sizing data below is sourced from independent third-party research.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0012 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Built by InGen Dynamics .]
Built by InGen Dynamics .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0013 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Built by InGen Dynamics .]
InGen Dynamics is a robotics and artificial intelligence company developing intelligent systems across education, inspection, and security verticals. Senpai is one of the company's primary active development programmes.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0014 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Built by InGen Dynamics .]
All InGen Dynamics products are built on the Origami AI platform — a proprietary multi-model AI architecture developed in-house for physical AI companions and autonomous robotic systems. The company is currently in an active development phase across its full product portfolio.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0015 | heading | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Interested in learning more ?]
Interested in learning more ?

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0016 | paragraph | Intelligent education, built for every child. > Interested in learning more ?]
We welcome enquiries from educational institutions, research partners, and those interested in following InGen Dynamics' development journey.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0017 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child.]
Senpai — the companion that grows with every child.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0018 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child.]
A physical AI educational companion designed for children aged 3 to 18 and beyond. Every hardware and software decision has been made with one question in mind: what does this child need right now, and how do we deliver it in a way that feels natural, warm, and genuinely helpful?

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0019 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Physical presence is the point .]
Physical presence is the point .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0020 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Physical presence is the point .]
Children engage more deeply with physical companions than with screens. Every hardware decision in Senpai's design starts from this premise — not as a marketing claim, but as a design constraint that propagates through the entire system.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0021 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Physical presence is the point .]
The result is a robot designed to express warmth and attentiveness through its face, its posture, and the way it moves. Its expressions draw on Disney's 12 Principles of Animation — anticipation, squash and stretch, follow-through — because we believe the qualities of a great teacher should not be lost in translation to technology.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0022 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Grounded in 30 years of learning science .]
Grounded in 30 years of learning science .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0023 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Grounded in 30 years of learning science .]
Senpai's pedagogical framework draws on the most robustly evidenced methods in educational psychology: retrieval practice, spaced repetition, elaborative interrogation, and multimodal encoding. These are not buzzwords — they are the approaches with the strongest and most replicated evidence base for long-term learning.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0024 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Any surface becomes a learning space .]
Any surface becomes a learning space .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0025 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Any surface becomes a learning space .]
Senpai's 720p projector (with an engineering upgrade path to 1080p) is designed to cast interactive content onto any nearby surface — a table, a floor, a wall — at up to 100 inches from 1.5 metres. Auto-keystone correction and autofocus are designed to make surface calibration automatic.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0026 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Any surface becomes a learning space .]
The projector system uses a depth camera to map the projection surface and track finger position at up to 60 frames per second — making the projected surface interactive. Children are designed to be able to tap, drag, and draw directly on the projected content.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0027 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Any surface becomes a learning space .]
This capability unlocks learning experiences that are genuinely physical — handwriting practice on a real surface, collaborative mapping exercises, finger-drawn maths on a table — rather than simulated physical interaction through a touchscreen.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0028 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Three surfaces. Three perspectives .]
Three surfaces. Three perspectives .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0029 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Three surfaces. Three perspectives .]
Senpai's data is designed to surface differently for each stakeholder — the teacher needs teaching intelligence, the student needs a learning adventure, and the parent needs transparency in plain language.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0030 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 20 subjects. Ages 3–18. One platform.]
20 subjects. Ages 3–18. One platform.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0031 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 20 subjects. Ages 3–18. One platform.]
Senpai's content library is being developed to cover the full breadth of school-age education — with curriculum alignment for major national frameworks built in from the start rather than retrofitted. Every subject is designed to support both classroom deployment and independent home learning.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0032 | heading | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 40+ languages. Conversation first .]
40+ languages. Conversation first .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0033 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 40+ languages. Conversation first .]
Senpai's approach to language learning is being built around one principle: that conversation produces fluency faster than vocabulary memorisation. The system is designed to prioritise getting children speaking as early as possible, then building grammar and vocabulary knowledge to support and extend that conversation.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0034 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 40+ languages. Conversation first .]
Pronunciation coaching is designed to use spectral audio analysis to compare a student's pronunciation against age-appropriate reference models for each language — giving feedback that is specific, actionable, and kind.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0035 | paragraph | Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > 40+ languages. Conversation first .]
The EAL (English as Additional Language) module is designed as a separate configuration — delivering curriculum content in a student's home language while gradually increasing the proportion of English as their confidence grows.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0036 | heading | Every learner deserves a great teacher.]
Every learner deserves a great teacher.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0037 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher.]
SEND is not a feature we added to Senpai. It is a primary design constraint that has shaped every hardware and software decision from day one. This page describes our inclusion framework, our six adaptation modes, and the child safety architecture we are building.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0038 | heading | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > A large, underserved market with a genuine human need.]
A large, underserved market with a genuine human need.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0039 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > A large, underserved market with a genuine human need.]
The SEND education market is one of the most structurally underserved in education technology. Existing products either exclude SEND learners entirely or treat accessibility as a visual design exercise — changing font sizes and contrast ratios without fundamentally changing how learning is delivered.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0040 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > A large, underserved market with a genuine human need.]
We believe that genuine inclusion means designing the entire learning interaction around the needs of each child — not appending accessibility features to a product designed for a neurotypical majority. This is not just the right thing to do. It is a commercial opportunity that the market has largely failed to address.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0041 | heading | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Six modes. Each a coherent design system .]
Six modes. Each a coherent design system .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0042 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Six modes. Each a coherent design system .]
Each adaptation mode represents a comprehensive set of interaction design decisions — not a checklist of visual adjustments. Every mode is designed to be activatable individually or in combination, recognising that many students have overlapping needs.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0043 | heading | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Safety built into the model — not filtered on top of it.]
Safety built into the model — not filtered on top of it.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0044 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Safety built into the model — not filtered on top of it.]
SEOM — the Safety and Ethics Operations Model — is a set of 12 rules being designed to govern every Senpai interaction with a child. Rather than relying on post-generation content filtering, these rules are intended to be embedded at the AI training objective level: the model is designed not to learn unsafe interaction patterns in the first place.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0045 | heading | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Designed for global compliance from first principles .]
Designed for global compliance from first principles .

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0046 | paragraph | Every learner deserves a great teacher. > Designed for global compliance from first principles .]
Rather than building for one regulatory framework and retrofitting for others, Senpai's design is intended to satisfy the intersection of the most demanding requirements across all target markets simultaneously. Note: compliance validation will be conducted through appropriate certification bodies during the development process — the frameworks below describe design intent.

Senpai's architecture implements a three-tier design: edge compute (on the robot) for real-time student interaction, a local classroom server for coordination and MIS integration, and cloud infrastructure for fleet management and model training. Core learning functions are designed to run on-device, with cloud connectivity optional rather than required.

Student (who needs joy and challenge), teacher (who needs insight and time-saving), parent (who needs transparency), and SENCO (who needs evidence). These six principles define how every interface decision is made.

The Senpai robot display uses a warm dark indigo palette — "Knowledge Studio" — entirely distinct from clinical, corporate, or consumer-tech aesthetics. Functional signal colours are reserved for specific semantic meanings and never mixed. The Senpai public website and dashboards use InGen Orange as the primary brand accent on a warm cream foundation.

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0096 | heading | Design system, screen layouts, interactions . > Motion that teaches , not decorates.]

[SOURCE_BLOCK PUB-SENPAI-20260812::block-0097 | paragraph | Design system, screen layouts, interactions . > Motion that teaches , not decorates.]
Senpai's motion language is warm but purposeful. Achievement animations are designed to activate the reward system. LED ring states communicate emotion and activity to the entire classroom without words. All animations are capped at ≤3 Hz to prevent photosensitive responses — SEOM E01 enforces this at the animation system level.

source_blocks.text: A physical AI educational companion designed for children aged 3 to 18 and beyond. Every hardware and software decision has been made with one question in mind: what does this child need right now, and how do we deliver it in a way that feels natural, warm, and genuinely helpful?

source_blocks.text: Children engage more deeply with physical companions than with screens. Every hardware decision in Senpai's design starts from this premise — not as a marketing claim, but as a design constraint that propagates through the entire system.

source_blocks.path: Senpai — the companion that grows with every child. > Physical presence is the point .
source_blocks.text: The result is a robot designed to express warmth and attentiveness through its face, its posture, and the way it moves. Its expressions draw on Disney's 12 Principles of Animation — anticipation, squash and stretch, follow-through — because we believe the qualities of a great teacher should not be lost in translation to technology.

source_blocks.text: The SEND education market is one of the most structurally underserved in education technology.
